text:
Lamps can be connected in series or in parallel to a power supply.
What is an advantage of connecting the lamps in parallel rather than in series?
A
All of the lamps can be switched on and off using the same switch.
B
Fewer connecting leads are needed to make the circuit.
C
When one lamp stops working, the others may continue to work.
D
Less power is transferred from the supply.

options.label: A
options.text: All of the lamps can be switched on and off using the same switch.

options.label: B
options.text: Fewer connecting leads are needed to make the circuit.

options.label: C
options.text: When one lamp stops working, the others may continue to work.

options.label: D
options.text: Less power is transferred from the supply.
